_doc: Tuning for scripts/ingest-business-info.ts — the business deep-info agent. It does NOT list URLs: it reads the website each place already has in src/data/places-enrichment.json (2,887 have one) and extracts what Google misses — known-for, happy hours, recurring specials, published hours, reservations. This config controls WHICH businesses to read and how often. typeIncludes/excludeDomains are substring matches. Add ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (repo secret) to run; the agent validates each fetch, falls back to a headless render when a site is JS-only, and NEVER fabricates.
